stateEncoding: UTF-8 JSON sorted keys with compact separators and ensure_ascii=false; state SHA excludes trailing newline. Full before/after states and root test/replace operations supplied for each event.
profiles: Actor profile SHA binds the full acquired class cards, original card text, background/ancestry, progression and known/prepared ledger; immutable profile data is not duplicated inside every state.
conditionSources: actors.conditions holds physical/lifecycle conditions (Unconscious, Prone, Incapacitated). Source-owned Stunned and protections are completely represented in effects, including sourceCast, target, actual rank, suppression and original endpoint. Remaining budgets are resource inventory; an operative condition can prohibit their use without refunding/spending them.
audiences: world/privateAudit are Director evidence. delivered and accessible learned memories are recipient data. Source metadata never grants a character access to private audit.
clocks: Every actor has actual independent regular start/end ledger, budget refreshes, recharge and Ready timing. Event states at a shared timestamp may retain next pending same-timestamp marker until its ordered event; final states contain no stale marker.
RNG: All listed die faces are explicit conditional branch inputs. No campaign die, supplied source program or runtime engine executed.
archive: Only explicit clean deliverables, exact input packet/delivery, and ten additional exact current sources. Input packet nested member manifest and all157 nested members remain unchanged. Supplied/historical executable bytes inside exact archival evidence are never executed.
